g.text: 4 in (101.6 mm) square: measure to check the scale
Projector card 24 × 18 in: a medium cutting mat ruled in inches
Calibrate the projector, then measure the 4 in square at the centre and the 2 in square in each corner. Centre right but corners differ: keystone. One side long: skew. Circle
not round: both. Everything the same but wrong: scale.
Lines are 2 mm wide, like a Grain-Nest export. Measure to the middle of the line.
